title: EG&G as AEC/DOE prime contractor running the Nevada Test Site

tellings.quote: EGNG became the AEC's prime contractor and later filled the same role for the Department of Energy.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a company called EG&G became the main contractor for the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran nuclear weapons work, starting around the 1950s at the Nevada Test Site, where the US tested nuclear bombs. He says it later played the same role for the Department of Energy, the agency that took over that work. Michels tells it to show how one private company sat at the centre of America's most secret sites.
